name: increasing_angle
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; not bird_released; not angle_adjusted; min_angle ≤ angle ≤ max_angle
effect: angle -= #t · angle_rate; angle_rad ← (angle − #t·angle_rate − angle_bias) · π/180; cosine ← 1 − a²/2 + a⁴/24 − a⁶/720 (a = angle_rad); sinus ← a − a³/6 + a⁵/120
inputs: bird: bird_id, bird_released · global: active_bird, angle, min_angle, max_angle, angle_rate, angle_bias, angle_rad, angle_adjusted
description: The aim angle *decreases* while the bird is in the sling and the angle is not locked. The trig uses the post-step angle.

name: decreasing_force
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; not bird_released; not force_locked; min_force ≤ v_bird_multiplier ≤ max_force
inputs: bird: bird_id, bird_released · global: active_bird, v_bird_multiplier, min_force, max_force, force_rate, force_locked
description: Pull strength ramps down until set_force locks it.

name: flying
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_released; not platform_slide_active; y_bird > 0
effect: y_bird += #t/100 · vy_bird; vy_bird -= #t/100 · gravity; x_bird += #t/100 · vx_bird; mod ← 0
inputs: bird: bird_id, x_bird, y_bird, vx_bird, vy_bird, bird_released, platform_slide_active · global: active_bird, gravity
description: Ballistic flight whenever the bird is released and not sliding.

name: platform_sliding
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_released; platform_slide_active(?b); bird_sliding(?b, ?pl); vx_bird > 0; x_bird − 0.35r ≤ x_platform + pw/2; x_bird + 0.35r ≥ x_platform − pw/2
learnt: {SE-platform-friction} — the friction term (median of kb._platform_friction, default 10.0)
effect: y_bird ← line(pl, x_bird) + 0.35r; vy_bird ← 0; x_bird += #t/100 · vx_bird; vx_bird += #t/100 · gravity · platform_slide_accel; vx_bird -= #t/100 · 10.0; mod ← 0
inputs: bird: bird_id, x_bird, vx_bird, bird_radius, bird_released, platform_slide_active, bird_sliding · platform: x_platform, platform_width, platform_line_c, platform_slope, platform_slide_accel · global: active_bird, gravity
description: The bird rides the platform's top edge. Slope acceleration and friction act on vx_bird.

name: block_platform_rolling
precondition: block_slide_active(?bl); block_sliding(?bl, ?pl); vx_block > 0; v_block > 0; x_block − w/2 ≤ x_platform + pw/2; x_block + w/2 ≥ x_platform − pw/2
learnt: {SE-platform-friction} — the friction term (median of kb._platform_friction, default 10.0)
effect: y_block ← line(pl, x_block) + h/2; vy_block ← 0; x_block += #t/100 · vx_block; vx_block += #t/100 · gravity · platform_slide_accel; vx_block -= #t/100 · 10.0; v_block ← vx_block; mod ← 0
inputs: block: x_block, block_width, block_height, vx_block, v_block, block_slide_active, block_sliding · platform: x_platform, platform_width, platform_line_c, platform_slope, platform_slide_accel · global: gravity
description: A pushed block rolls along a platform top.

name: agent_movement
precondition: angle_adjusted; not agent_dead(?ea)
inputs: external_agent: x_agent, y_agent, vx_agent, vy_agent, timing_agent, agent_dead · global: angle_adjusted
description: External agents move once the bird has been launched.

name: collision_ground
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_released; y_bird ≤ 0; vx_bird > 0
learnt: {SE-collision-ground-effect} — entire effect replaced: LR → M5 → roll placeholder, from kb.collision. Shown here: the current LR.
inputs: bird: bird_id, x_bird, y_bird, vx_bird, vy_bird, bird_released · global: active_bird
description: Learned ground bounce. It fires at y ≤ 0, not at the game floor of 360 (known bug #3).

name: explode_bird
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_released; bounce_count ≥ 3 or x_bird ≥ 800; angle_adjusted
inputs: bird: bird_id, bounce_count, x_bird, bird_released · global: active_bird, min_angle, angle_adjusted
description: Ends the current bird's shot and moves on to the next bird.

name: collision_pig_kill
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; v_bird > 0; (x_bird − x_pig)² + (y_bird − y_pig)² ≤ (r + pig_radius − 4.0)²; not pig_dead(?p); pig_life ≤ v_bird
effect: vx_bird, vy_bird ← 2D elastic-collision response, scaled by 2·m_pig/(m_bird + m_pig); +pig_dead(?p); +pig_killed; points_score += 5000
inputs: bird: bird_id, v_bird, x_bird, y_bird, vx_bird, vy_bird, bird_radius, m_bird · pig: x_pig, y_pig, pig_radius, m_pig, pig_life, pig_dead · global: active_bird, points_score
description: Direct bird–pig hit. The overlap test uses a 4.0 epsilon; the Python sim uses 2.0.

name: collision_block_bounce_off
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; v_bird > 0; AABB overlap: |x_bird − x_block| ≤ r + w/2, |y_bird − y_block| ≤ r + h/2; block_life > 0; v_bird ≥ block_stability; block_life² > (vx_bird² + vy_bird²) · bird_block_damage²
learnt: {SE-block-push-ratio} — the 0.18 factor (median of kb._block_push, default 0.18, not persisted)
effect: vx_block ← 0.18 · vx_bird; vy_block ← 0.18 · vy_bird; v_block ← 0.18 · v_bird; v_bird ← 0, vx_bird ← 0, vy_bird ← 0; bounce_count ← 3
inputs: bird: bird_id, v_bird, x_bird, y_bird, vx_bird, vy_bird, bird_radius, bird_block_damage(?b,?bl) · block: x_block, y_block, block_width, block_height, block_life, block_stability · global: active_bird
description: The bird can't break the block: it stops dead and pushes the block.

name: collision_block
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; v_bird > 0; AABB overlap (as above); block_life > 0; block_life² ≤ (vx_bird² + vy_bird²) · bird_block_damage²
learnt: {SE-block-push-ratio} — the 0.18 factor (median of kb._block_push, default 0.18, not persisted)
effect: vx_block ← 0.18 · vx_bird; vy_block ← 0.18 · vy_bird; v_block ← 0.18 · v_bird; bounce_count ← 3
inputs: bird: bird_id, v_bird, x_bird, y_bird, vx_bird, vy_bird, bird_radius, bird_block_damage(?b,?bl) · block: x_block, y_block, block_width, block_height, block_life · global: active_bird
description: The bird breaks through. bounce_count ← 3 ends its shot, via explode_bird. Block life is *not* reduced.

name: remove_unsupported_block
precondition: block_life(top) > 0; block_stability(top) > 0; block_life(bottom) ≤ 0 or block_stability(bottom) ≤ 0; |x_block(bottom) − x_block(top)| ≤ w(top)/2; y_block(bottom) ≤ y_block(top) − h(top)/2
effect: block_life(top) ← block_life(top) − 100; y_block(top) ← h(top)/2; block_stability(top) ← 0; points_score += 500
inputs: block (both): x_block, y_block, block_life, block_stability; top only: block_width, block_height · global: points_score
description: The top block falls when its support is destroyed or unstable.

name: explode_block
precondition: block_life(near) > 0; block_stability(near) > 0; |x_block(tnt) − x_block(near)| ≤ 100; |y_block(tnt) − y_block(near)| ≤ 100; block_explosive(tnt); block_life(tnt) ≤ 0
inputs: block: x_block, y_block, block_life (both), block_stability (near), block_explosive (tnt) · global: points_score
description: TNT chain reaction. The radius is 100, widened from 50 to model chains. It never fires in practice because block_explosive is never set (bug #11).

name: explode_pig
precondition: not pig_dead(?p); block_explosive(tnt); block_life(tnt) ≤ 0; |x_block − x_pig| ≤ 50; |y_block − y_pig| ≤ 50
inputs: block: x_block, y_block, block_life, block_explosive · pig: x_pig, y_pig, pig_dead · global: points_score
description: A pig dies inside the TNT blast radius.

name: remove_unsupported_pig
precondition: not pig_dead(?p); block_life < 0 or block_stability ≤ 0; |x_pig − x_block| ≤ w/2; y_block + h/2 ≤ y_pig ≤ y_block + h + pig_radius
inputs: block: x_block, y_block, block_width, block_height, block_life, block_stability · pig: x_pig, y_pig, pig_radius, pig_dead · global: points_score
description: A pig dies when the block under it fails. Note the strict < 0 on life here, versus ≤ 0 in remove_unsupported_block.

name: collision_block_pig_kill
precondition: not pig_dead(?p); block_life > 0; v_block > 10; AABB overlap: |x_block − x_pig| ≤ w/2 + pig_radius, |y_block − y_pig| ≤ h/2 + pig_radius
inputs: block: x_block, y_block, block_width, block_height, block_life, v_block · pig: x_pig, y_pig, pig_radius, pig_dead · global: points_score
description: A moving block (pushed or rolling) crushes a pig.

name: collision_platform
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_released; not platform_slide_active(?b); v_bird > 0; |x_bird − x_platform| ≤ 1.1r + pw/2; y_bird + r ≥ line(pl, x_bird) − platform_height; y_bird − r ≤ line(pl, x_bird); y_bird > line(pl, x_bird) + 0.35r (approach from above)
learnt: {SE-collision-platform-effect} — entire effect replaced. vx_bird and v_bird come from: LR v_x → learned ratio → heuristic ×0.35, from kb.platform_collision. The snap, vy ← 0 and slide-start lines are always present. Shown here: the current learned value, 1.0·vx.
effect: y_bird ← line(pl, x_bird) + 0.35r; vx_bird ← 1.0 · vx_bird; v_bird ← 1.0 · vx_bird; vy_bird ← 0; +platform_slide_active(?b); +bird_sliding(?b, ?pl); mod ← 2
inputs: bird: bird_id, x_bird, y_bird, v_bird, vx_bird, bird_radius, bird_released, platform_slide_active · platform: x_platform, platform_width, platform_height, platform_line_c, platform_slope · global: active_bird
description: First landing on a platform; the bird switches to slide mode.

name: platform_slide_handoff
precondition: platform_slide_active(?b); bird_sliding(?b, ?from); platform_chain(?from, ?to); vx_bird > 0; x_bird − 0.35r > x_platform(from) + pw(from)/2
inputs: bird: x_bird, vx_bird, bird_radius, platform_slide_active, bird_sliding · platform: x_platform, platform_width (from); platform_line_c, platform_slope (to); platform_chain
description: The slide carries over onto the next platform in the chain.

name: platform_slide_stop
precondition: platform_slide_active(?b); bird_sliding(?b, ?pl); vx_bird ≤ 0; bounce_count < 3
inputs: bird: vx_bird, bounce_count, platform_slide_active, bird_sliding
description: Friction stops the bird on the platform, which ends the shot. The slide flags stay set.

name: platform_slide_end
precondition: platform_slide_active(?b); bird_sliding(?b, ?pl); ( not platform_has_next(?pl) and x_bird − 0.35r > x_platform + pw/2 ) or x_bird + 0.35r < x_platform − pw/2
inputs: bird: x_bird, bird_radius, platform_slide_active, bird_sliding · platform: x_platform, platform_width, platform_has_next
description: The bird slides off the platform edge and flying takes over again.

name: collision_block_platform
precondition: not block_slide_active(?bl); block_life > 0; v_block > 0; |x_block − x_platform| ≤ w/2 + pw/2; platform_top_y_min − platform_height/2 ≤ y_block − h/2 ≤ platform_top_y_max + h/2
learnt: Generated, not learnt: {SE-block-platform-roll-effect} is always replaced by this fixed body
effect: y_block ← line(pl, x_block) + h/2; vy_block ← 0; v_block ← vx_block; +block_slide_active(?bl); +block_sliding(?bl, ?pl); mod ← 2
inputs: block: x_block, y_block, block_width, block_height, block_life, v_block, vx_block, block_slide_active · platform: x_platform, platform_width, platform_height, platform_top_y_min, platform_top_y_max, platform_line_c, platform_slope
description: A moving block lands on a platform and starts rolling.

name: block_platform_roll_handoff
precondition: block_slide_active(?bl); block_sliding(?bl, ?from); platform_chain(?from, ?to); vx_block > 0; x_block − w/2 > x_platform(from) + pw(from)/2
inputs: block: x_block, block_width, block_height, vx_block, block_slide_active, block_sliding · platform: x_platform, platform_width (from); platform_line_c, platform_slope (to); platform_chain
description: The block's roll carries over onto the next platform in the chain.

name: block_platform_roll_end
precondition: block_slide_active(?bl); block_sliding(?bl, ?pl); vx_block ≤ 0 or v_block ≤ 0 or ( not platform_has_next(?pl) and x_block − w/2 > x_platform + pw/2 ) or x_block + w/2 < x_platform − pw/2
inputs: block: x_block, block_width, vx_block, v_block, block_slide_active, block_sliding · platform: x_platform, platform_width, platform_has_next
description: The block stops, or rolls off the platform.

name: explode_block_from_bird
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_type = 2 (BLACK); bounce_count > 0; block_stability > 0; block_life > 0; |x_bird − x_block| ≤ 50; |y_bird − y_block| ≤ 50
inputs: bird: bird_id, bird_type, bounce_count, x_bird, y_bird · block: x_block, y_block, block_life, block_stability · global: active_bird
description: A black bird's explosion destroys nearby blocks. The or is commented out, so the bird must be BLACK and have bounced. The extra ) after this event closes the domain early.

name: explode_pig_from_bird
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_type = 2 or bounce_count = 3 or platform_slide_active(?b); not pig_dead(?p); |x_bird − x_pig| ≤ 50; |y_bird − y_pig| ≤ 50
inputs: bird: bird_id, bird_type, bounce_count, x_bird, y_bird, platform_slide_active · pig: x_pig, y_pig, pig_dead · global: active_bird, points_score
description: Proximity kill: any pig within ±50 of a stopped or sliding bird.

name: explode_pig_from_egg
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_type = 3 (WHITE); bounce_count = 3; not pig_dead(?p); |x_bird − x_pig| ≤ 40; |y_bird − y_pig| ≤ 40; bird_tapped(?b)
inputs: bird: bird_id, bird_type, bounce_count, x_bird, y_bird, bird_tapped · pig: x_pig, y_pig, pig_dead · global: active_bird, points_score
description: A white bird's egg kills a pig within ±40.

name: agent_1_timed_change_direction
precondition: angle_adjusted; not agent_dead(?ea); agent_type = 1 (WIZARD); timing_agent ≥ 1000
inputs: external_agent: agent_type, timing_agent, vx_agent, vy_agent, agent_dead · global: angle_adjusted
description: The wizard reverses direction on a timer. timing_agent is never reset, so the event re-fires on every step after the threshold.

name: agent_x_border_change_direction
precondition: angle_adjusted; not agent_dead(?ea); ( vx_agent > 0 and x_agent + agent_width/2 ≥ x_max_border ) or ( vx_agent < 0 and x_agent − agent_width/2 ≤ x_min_border )
inputs: external_agent: x_agent, agent_width, vx_agent, x_min_border, x_max_border, agent_dead · global: angle_adjusted

name: agent_y_border_change_direction
precondition: angle_adjusted; not agent_dead(?ea); ( vy_agent > 0 and y_agent + agent_height/2 ≥ y_max_border ) or ( vy_agent < 0 and y_agent − agent_height/2 ≤ y_min_border )
inputs: external_agent: y_agent, agent_height, vy_agent, y_min_border, y_max_border, agent_dead · global: angle_adjusted

name: collision_agent
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; v_bird > 0; |x_bird − x_agent| ≤ r + agent_width/1.75; |y_bird − y_agent| ≤ r + agent_height/1.75
inputs: bird: bird_id, v_bird, x_bird, y_bird, bird_radius · external_agent: x_agent, y_agent, agent_width, agent_height · global: active_bird
description: An external agent's hitbox stops the bird.

name: set_force
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; not bird_released; not force_locked
inputs: bird_id, bird_released, active_bird, force_locked

name: pa-twang
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; not bird_released; not angle_adjusted; force_locked
effect: vx_bird ← v_bird·v_bird_multiplier·cosine; vy_bird ← v_bird·v_bird_multiplier·sinus; x_bird -= 16·cosine; y_bird -= 12·sinus; +bird_released; +angle_adjusted
inputs: bird_id, v_bird, x_bird, y_bird, bird_released, active_bird, v_bird_multiplier, cosine, sinus, angle_adjusted, force_locked

name: yellow_bird_action
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_released; not bird_tapped; bounce_count = 0; x_bird < 800; bird_type = 1
inputs: bird_id, bird_released, bird_tapped, bounce_count, x_bird, bird_type, vx_bird, vy_bird, v_bird, active_bird

name: white_bird_action
precondition: same as yellow, with bird_type = 3
effect: vx_bird ← 0; vy_bird ← 0; bird_radius ← bird_radius/1.5 and bird_radius ← bird_radius/2 (two conflicting assigns to the same fluent); +bird_tapped
inputs: bird_id, bird_released, bird_tapped, bounce_count, x_bird, bird_type, bird_radius, active_bird

name: black_bird_action
precondition: active_bird = bird_id; bird_released; not bird_tapped; bounce_count < 3; x_bird < 800; bird_type = 2
inputs: bird_id, bird_released, bird_tapped, bounce_count, x_bird, bird_type, active_bird

name: switch_bird
precondition: bird_released; active_bird = bird_id; vx_bird = 0
inputs: bird_released, bird_id, vx_bird, active_bird
